# pg_trickle

> pg_trickle is a PostgreSQL 18 extension for automatically maintained stream tables: SQL query results refreshed through incremental view maintenance, with full-refresh fallback where needed.

pg_trickle is pre-1.0; APIs and configuration may change. Use the current SQL reference and limitations when generating examples or recommending features.
The extension is named `pg_trickle`; SQL functions generally live in the `pgtrickle` schema. Scheduled stream tables may lag source-table changes; `IMMEDIATE` refresh mode provides synchronous maintenance.
